MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The caliper feels like a useful next choice because measuring component dimensions and clearances supports the electronics assembly and hardware projects reflected in my history.",
    "The thermal camera connects with my infrared thermometer use and electronics interests, although I would need a specific inspection task and compatible phone before choosing it.",
    "The metric lock nut assortment and epoxy fit my broader DIY interests, but I would wait for a project that establishes the required sizes or bonding needs."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The belt, threaded inserts and 3/8-inch lock nuts require exact repair or assembly needs that my history does not establish; being workshop supplies does not make those specifications useful to me now.",
    "The precision parallels, deck screws and O-ring kit assume machining, woodworking or sealing work that I have not indicated I am doing."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics parts and workshop hardware seems to have been stretched into a general need for unrelated repair supplies.",
    "My caster purchase seems to have been treated as a reason to suggest mounting hardware without knowing the attachment method or thread sizes I need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My breadboards, PCB supplies and relay suggest hands-on electronics assembly, where tools for measuring and checking components have a clearer purpose than specialized mechanical repair parts.",
    "I choose moderately and need a concrete use: an item can fit my interests without being something I would buy now.",
    "Exact dimensions, thread compatibility and device compatibility matter when deciding whether a related item will actually work for my project."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my DIY interests but often assumed specific repair needs, while the caliper offered a clearer connection to my electronics and hardware work."
}
